title.narrative: CCLIP Neighborhood Upgrading Program, First Individual Project
CCLIP Programa de Mejoramiento de Barrios, Primer proyecto individual

description.narrative: El objetivo del programa es mejorar la calidad de vida de la poblacin con necesidades bsicas insatisfechas y bajos ingresos, asentada en barrios de aglomerados urbanos, con carencia de infraestructura bsica de servicios y equipamiento comunitario, deficiencias severas de vivienda, y problemas ambientales y de regularizacin dominial.

The CCLIP and the Individual Loan will contribute to the sustainable improvement of the habitat of the families living in irregular neighborhoods with severe deficiencies in public infrastructure, and do not enjoy ownership of the properties in which they live. The CCLIP and the Individual Loan will have four components: i) Public infrastructure and equipment; ii) Land tenure legalization; iii) Increase of social and human capital; and iv) Institutional strengthening at national and local levels.
